Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring adoption of rules regulating offcampus conduct.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offcampus disruptive behavior of highereducation students; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each institution of higher education shall adopt rulesregarding disruptive offcampus conduct of students, includingsanctions. Sanctions may include, but are not limited to, counseling,probation, suspension, or expulsion. (2) As used in this section, "disruptive offcampus conduct" meansany conduct that results in a citation or conviction for the violationof laws or ordinances and that: (a) Interferes with the institution of higher education'srelationship with the surrounding community; (b) Harms the reputation of the institution of higher education; or (c) Violates the institution of higher education's policies. (3) As used in this section, "offcampus" means neighborhoods,businesses, and public places that are proximate to the campus of theinstitution. p. 1 HB 2123 (4) Rules adopted under this section may not violate the civilrights of students protected under the Constitution of the UnitedStates or the state of Washington. The rules must also provide dueprocess procedures for students who have been accused of disruptiveoffcampus conduct. (5) Each institution of higher education shall report the substanceof the rules adopted under this section to the higher educationcommittees of the legislature by December 1, 2005.
